added.name: Armorer Labs
added.long_description:
Armorer helps companies in regulated industries ship their own AI agents faster and keep them secure in production.

Most security tools flag an issue and file a ticket. Armorer assesses your agent and simulates attacks to find the real issues. Then it creates a verified fix that stops the attack without breaking the business, ready for your approval in about 4 hours.

In production, Armorer checks every agent action in milliseconds, with no GPU needed. It detects malicious behavior such as prompt injection, goal hijacking and data leaks, then allows, holds or denies the action.

Armorer's detection models beat every other detector we tested on six public benchmarks. Armorer is 22% more accurate than JEV while being 88x faster, so users won't feel the delay.

We spent years building and evaluating AI security systems together at AWS, including its first customer-facing AI security agent, which scaled to 100k+ customers. Armorer is backed by Paul Vixie, Internet Hall of Fame inductee and former AWS Deputy CISO.
added.one_liner: Continuous security verification for AI agents in regulated industries

long_description.before:
Dialogus builds Duet, the operating layer for companies run by people and agents.

Every company now has an AI mandate, but most stall after one or two automations. The rest of operations is a long tail of workflows like claims, disputes, approvals and exceptions that run on rules nobody ever wrote down.

Duet learns how your company actually works, from the tools your team uses and the way they really do the work. It turns those workflows into agents, proves each one alongside your team before it acts, and runs it with hard limits and full audit.

Every workflow teaches Duet more about your company, so the next one goes live faster. The result: companies automate dozens of workflows, not one or two.

long_description.before:
Sutrix turns messy EHR records into clean, study-ready datasets by deploying ai systems within hospital research teams' enviornment.

Before a clinical study can start, research staff spend weeks pulling records, reading notes chart by chart and fixing conflicting entries in spreadsheets. Sutrix automates that work inside each hospital's own systems. It applies the study's rules and flags unclear cases for staff to review.

Paying research teams at HSS, Emory, and Mount Sinai cut data prep from 3 weeks per study to 4 days, and now they are able to deliver tailored patient outcomes faster.

We built Sutrix because we lived this problem. Ritvik ran clinical research at HSS and Emory, and Supratik previously founded Kairo (a16z Speedrun, exited) and was an engineer at Amazon.
long_description.after:
Sutrix turns messy data from EHRs, clinical notes, wearables, and surveys into clean, study-ready datasets allowing hospital research teams' to deliver tailored patient care faster.

Before a clinical study can start, research staff spend weeks pulling patient data from disconnected systems like the EHR, REDCap, and wearable platforms, reading notes chart by chart, and reconciling conflicting entries in spreadsheets. Sutrix automates that work by deploying AI systems within each team’s own environment, linking patient records across sources, applying the study's rules, and flagging unclear cases for staff to review.

Paying research teams at 10+ institutions cut data prep by 80% going from weeks per study to days.

We're brothers who've built together for 4 years. We first solved this problem doing forward-deployed work at HSS, where we built an injury surveillance system now used by 700+ teams. Ritvik's clinical research at HSS and Emory showed us every research team has the same bottleneck. Supratik previously founded Kairo (a16z Speedrun, exited) and built production AI agents at Amazon.
